airapps.board_introduction_html:
Join the Team at Air Apps and Shape the Future of Productivity!

At Air Apps, we’re transforming how people engage with technology. As a leader in creating innovative utility and productivity apps, we're on a mission to simplify everyday tasks for millions around the globe.

With over 100 million downloads and consistently high ratings (4.7 stars from over 2 million reviews), our top-ranked apps like Translate Now and Calculator Air are changing the way people interact with their devices.

Be a part of our dynamic, international team of 50+ passionate professionals who blend cutting-edge Apple design with smart solutions. Whether you’re a developer, designer, or marketer, your work will have a direct impact on enhancing the daily lives of users worldwide.

🔹 100M+ downloads
🔹 2M+ ratings with an average of 4.7 stars
🔹 Industry-leading apps that make life easier

Ready to innovate with us? Apply now to join a fast-growing company where your ideas will make a difference!

airwallex.board_introduction_html:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
airwallex.name: Airwallex

ashby.board_introduction_html:
Where we're coming from

Abhik and I started Ashby for two reasons.

First, we wanted to equip people & talent teams with much more powerful tools - matching the strategic importance these functions have for modern businesses.

Just as importantly, we wanted to build a world-class organization that delivers excellent products and customer experiences and constantly challenges the status quo.

This ambition spans every function: we’re known for our best in class product velocity (powered by an excellent and uniquely organized Engineering team). At the same time our customers view our Customer Success & Sales experience as a huge differentiator. We care deeply about making all touch points with the Ashby brand & people excellent - and we’re investing in the talent to make that possible.


Growth to date & what’s next

Having publicly launched in late 2022, we now serve over 5,000 global customers. We’re delivering top decile metrics across growth rates, retention & efficiency. All of our customer segments are experiencing rapid growth. We’re the default for new startups - and are rapidly growing our Enterprise segment as well. There’s a lot of organic love for what we’ve built.

We’re now entering our next phase of exciting growth by becoming a true multi-product company. As much as we’ve achieved significant scale, we’re still attracting builders and there’s a ton of exciting work ahead of us.

There’s a common belief that companies slow down as they scale. That they stop innovating. Become “political”. As much as Ashby is about solving the most important problems our customers face, it’s also about defying gravity when it comes to building a successful business.

Our operating principles (next section) are a big part of what have allowed us to deliver on both fronts in recent years.

How we work & what we value

We have published our operating principles on our blog - they describe how we work at Ashby. They cover how we aim to run projects, spend time and make decisions.

Beyond that we also look for specific attributes in new hires. Folks at Ashby are generally described as:

  • Humble and Empathetic

  • Curious

  • Driven

  • Reliable

  • Transparent and Honest

  • Don't Take Themselves Too-Seriously

You can read more about the "why" behind these attributes in the same blog post.
ashby.name: Ashby

causaprima.board_introduction_html:
Build the Future of Finance

Every year, $90 trillion moves between businesses — managed through duct-taped workflows, manual data entry, and spreadsheets. 68% of companies still key invoice data by hand. Trillions sit trapped as dead working capital.

Causa Prima is building the first agentic AI network for finance operations. Autonomous agents that don't just automate tasks — they negotiate across company boundaries, resolve disputes in real-time, and make financial decisions with real judgment. Not another dashboard. Not another workflow tool. A system that acts.

The real unlock is what happens at scale: every company that joins makes the network smarter. Agents negotiate with each other across the supply chain. A context graph captures the why behind every financial decision — creating a compounding data moat no competitor can replicate.

Why Join Us

🏗️ Ground floor of a category-defining company You won't maintain someone else's codebase. You'll make foundational decisions that shape the product, the architecture, and the culture for years to come.

🧠 World-class founders Three founders with complementary strengths across supply chain finance (Taulia — acquired by SAP), tokenization infrastructure (Centrifuge), and security-first fintech architecture (Oak Security, Finoa). Together: 10 startups, $400M+ raised, $bn of assets under management, 2 unicorns built.

🌱 Backed by the best $30M raised in the first six months ($10M pre-seed, $20M seed) from Base10, QED, Creandum and K Fund.

💎 Meaningful equity, not token grants All employees receive generous equity We believe in real ownership for the people who take the earliest risk.

⚡ Build with the best tools TypeScript · Python · LangGraph · LlamaIndex · Neo4j · PostgreSQL · Redis · React — chosen for the problems we're solving, not for trend-following.

📍 Madrid & Munich We believe the best early-stage work happens in person. Our hubs are in Madrid and Munich, with regular travel between the two.

What we offer beyond salary and equity


Health & wellness. Private health insurance via Alan for Spain-based hires (100% company-paid). ClassPass subscription for everyone, from gym access to back massages.
Everyday life covered. Pre-tax food and transport stipends in Spain via Alan Flex. Pre-tax food stipend in Germany. Deutschlandticket Job 100% covered for the Munich team.
Growth on us. L&D budget for courses, books, conferences, or certifications. Weekly English coaching sessions with a dedicated coach.
Welcome package. Noise-cancelling headphones and plenty of Causa Prima swag on day one.
causaprima.name: Causa Prima

clipboard.board_introduction_html:
About Clipboard

Our Why

At Clipboard, our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this by connecting healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers, helping people achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to people all across the U.S.

Our How

Clipboard is an app-based marketplace where workplaces post calls for help and workers answer. Every year, we help hundreds of thousands of workers fill millions of shifts across the U.S. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more.

Our Team

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to accelerate our work of uplifting communities across the country.

oviva.board_introduction_html:
Join our journey

Oviva is Europe’s leading digital health provider for weight-related conditions. We make this care accessible to everyone who needs it – reimbursed, at scale, and proven.

Founded in 2014 by Kai Eberhardt and Manuel Baumann, we’ve significantly improved the lives of more than 1 million patients across Germany, the UK, and Switzerland, backed by 100+ peer-reviewed publications.

Our AI-enabled care combines a medical-device-certified app with clinical teams of doctors, dietitian's, and behavioural specialists: reimbursed as a certified DiGA in Germany, in partnership with the NHS in the UK, and integrated into Swiss public healthcare. We treat obesity, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes, expanding further to become the long-term partner for chronic care in Europe.

Our mission: To build a healthier future for all, our mission is to provide the most accessible and effective care to people living with weight-related conditions

Why? Patients live healthier lives. Health systems become more sustainable. Societies remain healthier and more productive. We prove it by rigorously measuring and publishing our outcomes.
